replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states multi-gigabyte files and a parser job; resource exhaustion attack is concrete and design-linked."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Importer trusts CSV contents per design; concrete tampering of partner id/prices by uploader."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Untrusted CSV fields imported into orders DB; injection/formula attack distinct from T2's business-field spoofing."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design names SFTP partner uploads with no auth mechanism; credential spoofing yields forged imported orders."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Large files plus unqualified pickup supports truncated/duplicate import harm; concrete and distinct."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Shared SFTP server with no per-partner isolation; cross-partner read/overwrite of order files is concrete."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"No provenance recorded between upload and imported orders; attribution/dispute harm concrete to this import flow."}]}
